known_limitations: Briefing is intentionally concise and non-authoritative; it summarizes existing artifacts and reports missing optional inputs as warnings.
summary: Implemented Morning Briefing v1 generator, CLI integration, Markdown/JSON output generation, and representative test coverage for summaries and warning behavior.
tests_run: PYTHONPATH=src python -m estate.cli.main morning-briefing --json > /tmp/morning.json && python -m json.tool /tmp/morning.json >/dev/null && PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/test_morning_briefing.py -q
